items.summary:
GuruFocus
GuruFocus

# Nvidia unveils AI breakthrough that goes beyond chatbots

Nvidia Corp. (NVDA, Financials) unveiled its GR00T 2 robotics model and Isaac Lab 3.0 programming tools, advancing its attempts to apply artificial intelligence to physical devices.

The business unveiled the technique at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas. [...] The model may also transfer taught abilities to other robot designs, without the need for being demonstrated on each machine.

Nvidia stated GR0T 2 was among the top three models on a few robotics benchmarks, including RoboCasa365 and RoboLab.

The system may interact with AI agents through an application programming interface, perhaps enabling autonomous systems to coordinate more complicated operations. [...] GR00T 2 is an open robotics world model from the Cosmos platform from Nvidia. It was trained on both robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of open-source video from a person's point of view.

The model was able to do 40 out of 50 jobs it was tested on without task-specific examples, Nvidia says.

GR00T 2 performed successfully on 50 tasks, each with a single demonstration, with a success rate of 71%. That rose to 95% after five demonstrations.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
November 9, 2026

In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge. [...] The researchers then gave the AI that simulation and their Graph-as-Policy framework. The AI generated a robot-control program and repeatedly tested and improved it in simulation. When the researchers ran the resulting code on a real robot, it worked.

Six illustrations showing a robotic claw doing various industrial tasks, including hanging items on a wall and pulling cables through different configurations.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là một hàm Python tính số Fibonacci sử dụng phương pháp đệ quy (recursion):

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """Tính số Fibonacci thứ n sử dụng đệ quy.

    Lưu ý: n tính từ 0 (fibonacci(0) = 0, fibonacci(1) = 1).
    """
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("Số n phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0")
    # Điều kiện cơ sở (Base cases)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n == 1:
        return 1

    # Bước đệ quy
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Ví dụ sử dụng:
print(fibonacci(6))  # Kết quả: 8 (dãy: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8)
```

**Lưu ý:** Cách viết đệ quy thuần túy này rất trực quan nhưng có độ phức tạp về thời gian là $O(2^n)$, nên nó sẽ chạy rất chậm với các giá trị $n$ lớn (ví dụ $n > 30$). Nếu bạn cần tính cho các số lớn hơn, bạn có thể tham khảo phương pháp dùng quy hoạch động (dynamic programming) hoặc vòng lặp (iteration) để tối ưu hiệu năng.
